put.description: Payload must match Draft{element} schema. baseVersion starts at 0. Conflict returns conflict=true and saves the latest submitted value. Missing/foreign persons and episodes are rejected. First actual document must already be open. A new draft after scoring starts the next attempt; it is counted only on submit.

post.description: All five complete payloads required per episode. No reference →422. Global case limit3, final score=best; reassign does not reset it. Subject50; other four12.5 independently. Objective3 equally weighted subfields; subjective4 for intentional reference, otherwise3. F1 uses deduplicated sets, empty/empty=1. Notes are not graded. Multi-episode weighted mean; round only final total to2 decimals.
